name: print-social-fintech-social-profile-and-post-mockups
title: Fintech Social Profile Cover and Posts
whatItIs: A presentation board titled 'Social Media' showing a bank's Facebook profile with a wide cover of layered translucent glass sheets, an orange logo avatar, and two Instagram-style posts with 3D silver coins.
whatItMeans: Soft glass and pearlescent gradients feel modern and trustworthy while a single orange accent gives the brand a memorable voice. Showing real platform chrome proves the design works in context.
techniques: Fan of translucent glass panes as a banner illustration
One orange word in a black headline as the brand accent
Silver 3D objects on pale iridescent grounds for the feed posts
Real platform UI shown around the artwork for context
Generous grey margins so the board itself feels calm and premium
bestFor: Launch kits that need consistent profile and post visuals

vocabulary.definition: The wide banner image at the top of a social profile.
Translucent, blurred panels that suggest frosted glass.
A single word colored differently to carry emphasis.
